name: Christadelphians

citations.excerpt: a community founded in 1848 by John Thomas (1805–1871)

disagreements.excerpt: The Christadelphians were founded in 1844 by Dr. John Thomas.

citations.excerpt: There he at first joined the “Campbellites,” but afterwards struck out independently

facts.value: Deny the divinity of Jesus. Conditional immortality, a millenarian hope of a theocracy centred at Jerusalem, and congregations not ruled by employed clergy.

citations.excerpt: They deny the divinity of Jesus Christ and aspire to study scripture accurately in congregations not ruled by employed clergy.
